item.text:
Mixed, leaning slightly positive on direct public investment and regulatory repair, but weak on the deeper foundations of predictable property rights, local governance, education, and health. The strongest 2024 positives are IMF/World Bank-backed reform, reconstruction, MSME support, and formal procurement/safety rules; the main negatives are property-rights shocks and politicized local administration.

Even with stabilization underway, the operating environment remained costly and fragile for entrepreneurs and investors. | 5B.6, 5B.3, 5B.4 |

Search gap: I found little direct 2024 evidence in the materials searched on education and health investment specifically. The record is much stronger on infrastructure recovery, MSMEs, and regulatory/administrative repair than on a clearly documented, broad human-capital program.
